subject: Cerulean RFP - request to match competitor trial uplift
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@ceruleanhealth.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RFP trial uplift — can you match AxiomAI?

Hi Mateo,

Quick one — we received an offer from AxiomAI as part of our RFP for Q4 and they put forward a 120k-token trial credit + a 2-week extension of the sandbox window to complete our benchmark. That package materially impacts our evaluation plan and timelines.

Cerulean is trying to keep the bake-off fair; you’re one of our top vendors and we’d like to include Redwood, but we need a like-for-like trial uplift to consider you in the short list. Can you match the 120k tokens and the 2-week extension?

I’ve attached the RFP and our test plan so you can see the scope. Ideally we’d like confirmation before next Tuesday so we can finalize schedules.

Attachments: Cerulean_RFP_Q4.pdf (PDF), cerulean-test-plan.csv (CSV)

Thanks,
Samira
Sr. Procurement Manager
Cerulean Health
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@ceruleanhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP trial uplift — can you match AxiomAI?

Hi Samira — thanks for flagging this and for the materials.

We’d very much like to stay in the running. Before I loop in ops and credits, two quick clarifying Qs so we propose the right package:
- Is the 120k-token uplift intended as a single upfront stipend or tiered across testing phases?
- Any special infra needs (longer seqs, embeddings-heavy, real-time API vs batch)?

I’m bringing Olga (ops/credits) and Ben (pricing) into the thread to determine what we can authorize quickly. If it helps, I can propose a conditional offer tied to a milestone check-in — that’s often how we protect both sides.

I’ll follow up internally and come back with a specific proposal by EOD.

— Mateo
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: FWD: RFP trial uplift — Cerulean asking us to match competitor offer

Fwding Samira's note (below). TL;DR: Cerulean is asking us to match AxiomAI — 120k tokens + 2-week sandbox extension. Deal potential ~ $450k ARR if they select Redwood for inference.

Why I’m asking: this is a tight RFP window and if we don’t match they may drop us from side-by-side. I’d like to push an aggressive but protected credit package: propose 150k tokens + 3-week extension, front-loaded with a milestone check at week 2 to validate progress; if policy won’t allow that size, ask what the maximum is we can offer quickly.

Key risk: precedent for future RFPs, plus credits already committed this quarter.

Attachments: (RFP + test plan forwarded)

On Fri, 2 Oct 2026 at 09:14 Samira Khan <samira.khan@ceruleanhealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Mateo,
> 
> Quick one — we received an offer from AxiomAI as part of our RFP for Q4 and they put forward a 120k-token trial credit + a 2-week extension of the sandbox window to complete our benchmark. ...
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FWD: RFP trial uplift — Cerulean asking us to match competitor offer

Thanks for the context, Mateo. I pulled the relevant credit policy excerpt and ran a quick precedence check. Notes: 

- Policy ceiling for discretionary eval credits (sales-owned, no legal sign-off) this quarter is ~120k tokens for a single account without additional contractual commitments. Anything above that requires Finance sign-off or to be tied to a revenue milestone.
- Sandbox extension requests are low-friction — we can grant up to 3 weeks for an isolated sandbox environment if we constrain data ingress and mandate that production keys are not used.

Suggested offer that balances risk and competitiveness:
1) 100k tokens upfront + additional 25k tokens unlocked after a successful mid-point demo (week 2) — total 125k tokens.
2) 2-week sandbox extension (no production keys) — ops will provision a timeboxed env.
3) Require a short evaluation acceptance checklist and a mutual action plan (MAP) to be signed remotely (DocuSign link we can generate).

I’m attaching the policy excerpt for the sales playbook. If sales wants to push to 150k, we need a Finance/RevOps approval workflow (slower).

Attachment: credit-policy-excerpt.pdf

Olga
Director, Platform Ops
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FWD: RFP trial uplift — Cerulean asking us to match competitor offer

Thanks — I’m okay approving a competitive, conditional package given the $450k ARR potential and the strategic vertical fit. Approve the following:

- 120,000 trial tokens (upfront)
- 2-week sandbox extension
- Conditional add-on: 25k tokens to be released upon successful mid-point demo and MAP sign-off (requires a short check-in with CS engineer).

Please document the milestone (MAP) and ensure we get a signed acknowledgment that this is a limited-time evaluation package (no SLA, rev rec not affected).

Ben
Head of Demand Gen — Americas
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@ceruleanhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP trial uplift — can you match AxiomAI?

Hi Samira — can confirm the package we can offer quickly:

- 120,000 trial tokens upfront
- 2-week extension of the sandbox window (we’ll provision an isolated eval environment; no production keys allowed)
- An additional 25,000 tokens will be unlocked after a mid-point demo and completion of a short MAP checklist (we’ll generate the DocuSign for the MAP).

We’ll also schedule a kickoff with one of our CS engineers to ensure the benchmark runs smoothly. If that sounds good I’ll send the MAP and environment details and get the sandbox set up within 48 hours.

Best,
